public abstract class GanttChartBaseSkin<R extends Row<?,?,?>, C extends GanttChartBase<R>> extends SkinBase<C>
Base skin implementation for GanttChartBase. It assembles the timeline, graphics area, scroll bars, and master-detail panes and keeps them synchronized with the control state.
